title: Walmart Price & Stock Monitor by ZIP
description: Check a known list of Walmart products across US ZIP codes. Each product is checked in every ZIP, with a hard limit of 100 product × ZIP checks per run.

products.title: Walmart products
products.description: Add 1-100 Walmart item IDs or product URLs. Use reference to keep your own SKU or label in every result row. Cost scales with the matrix: every product is checked in every ZIP at $0.003 per successful validated check; failed and partial checks are free.

itemId.title: Walmart item ID
itemId.description: Numeric Walmart item ID, usually visible at the end of the product URL.

url.title: Walmart product URL
url.description: Alternative to itemId: a walmart.com product URL containing a numeric item ID.

reference.title: Your reference
reference.description: Optional customer SKU, alert label, or internal identifier returned as inputRef.

zipCodes.title: US ZIP codes
zipCodes.description: Add 1-5 valid five-digit US ZIP codes. Every product is checked in every ZIP, so 10 products x 3 ZIPs = 30 checks. Malformed ZIPs are rejected before source lookups or validated-check charges; the platform start fee can still apply.

monitorName.title: Monitor name
monitorName.description: Stable 3-64 character name used to compare this run with the previous successful observation for the same item and ZIP.

monitorKey.title: Legacy monitor key
monitorKey.description: Deprecated compatibility field for existing saved tasks. New integrations should use monitorName.

includeUnchanged.title: Include unchanged observations
includeUnchanged.description: Keep every validated row. Turn off to return only first baselines, real changes, and explicit failures; unchanged rows are hidden from the dataset but their validated checks are still billed because Walmart was queried and the store context verified. monitorName is required for change detection.

maxConcurrency.title: Validated request concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Fixed at the production-validated safe value.

proxyMode.title: Validated proxy route
proxyMode.description: US Residential Proxy is the validated production route.

failOnCriticalHealth.title: Fail on systemic outage
failOnCriticalHealth.description: Fails the run after writing diagnostics when every check returns a systemic failure and no validated row is produced.
